meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把混乱的代码拆解重组，理清结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头代码越改越乱，想在不改行为的前提下梳理结构
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code apart and rebuild it into clear structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has grown messy and you want to reorganize it without changing behavior

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 /refactor 流程走:先确认重构意图、扫描代码与依赖、评估测试覆盖,再生成分步计划逐步改动,每步都用 LSP 检查和跑测试验证。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、提取或现代化代码时触发;需要给出重构目标,含糊的「清理一下」它会先反问。

say.text: /refactor 把校验逻辑提取到独立模块
say.note: 先建代码地图与分步计划再动手

howto.what_en: Installs the /refactor command: Claude confirms your intent, maps the codebase and its test coverage, plans atomic steps, then refactors with LSP and AST-grep, running tests after each change.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code. You must name a target; vague "clean this up" requests get clarifying questions first.

say_en.note: Confirms intent, then touches only this file

say_en.text: /refactor extract validation logic into its own module
say_en.note: Builds a codemap and step plan first
Allows wider changes, still needs coverage
